name: Matrix
author: Erin Carter
description: Digital rain — columns of glyphs cascading from the top, each stream led by a bright white shining character with a long trail fading from green to dark, the symbols re-rolling as they fall and columns running at their own speeds. The classic falling code.

params.label: Columns
params.effect: How many glyph columns fill the frame; low is chunky letters, high a dense fine cascade.

params.label: Fall speed
params.effect: How fast the rain falls; 0 freezes it. Each column varies around this.

params.label: Trail
params.effect: Length of the fading trail behind each shining head; low is short, high streams the full column.

params.label: Glyph churn
params.effect: How fast the characters re-roll as they fall; 0 freezes the symbols, high keeps them flickering.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer brightens columns near it; 0 ignores the mouse.
